scope: Four original synthetic skill records, not the Hermes catalog, not executable tool integrations, and not evidence of model accuracy.
identity_policy: Portable lowercase skill names independent of corpus location; duplicate IDs are errors.

excerpt_policy.normalization: Normalize CRLF and CR to LF, then strip outer whitespace.
excerpt_policy.descriptions: Complete; never adaptively shortened for a backend.
excerpt_policy.rank_candidates: Every roster entry; no backend-specific candidate dropping.
excerpt_policy.privacy_order: Replace private-root spellings before taking the body excerpt.

algorithm.return_rule: Return the rerank Choice winner when the maximum shortlist fit meets the threshold, even when another candidate has the highest fit.
